result_explanation: The Home Loan Prepayment Calculator returns Original Total Interest, Revised Total Interest, Interest Saved. Results use verified formulas adapted for Indian market conditions.
calculator_engine: function prepayment(loan,rate,years,prepay,prepayYear){const r=rate/100/12;const n=years*12;const emi=loan*r*Math.pow(1+r,n)/(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1);const paidMonths=prepayYear*12;let outstanding=loan;for(let i=0;i<paidMonths;i++){outstanding=outstanding*(1+r)-emi;}outstanding-=prepay;const newN=Math.log(emi/(emi-outstanding*r))/Math.log(1+r);const interestOrig=emi*n-loan;const interestNew=emi*paidMonths+emi*newN-(loan-prepay);return{interestOrig,interestNew,saved:interestOrig-interestNew,timeSaved:n-paidMonths-newN};}
